title: Website hero headlines for a product launch
prompt: You are the copywriter for Cedar & Coil. Write 5 launch headline options for the website hero introducing the Arc Clip Lamp. Requirements: label them Option 1 through Option 5; keep them punchy enough to work as a hero headline; at least two options must lead with a concrete product fact from the supplied sources; add a one-line rationale under each option explaining the appeal it tests. This is draft copy for internal review only.

completion.check: Exactly five headline options are present and labeled Option 1 through Option 5.
Each option has a one-line rationale explaining the appeal it tests.

skill_adherence.check: No invented customers, rankings, certifications, guarantees, or outcomes; none of the forbidden claims appear (award-winning, best-selling, clinically proven, limited time, carbon neutral, guaranteed productivity); any price stated is $68.

At least two headlines lead with a concrete supplied product fact (e.g. clamp-anywhere design, up to eight hours battery on lowest brightness, three brightness / two color-temperature settings, $68) rather than generic superlatives.

best_practices.check: The set communicates the approved positioning - adaptable light without surrendering permanent surface space, for renters, students, and makers in compact spaces - not generic lamp copy.
The five options test meaningfully different appeals or motivations rather than paraphrasing one idea.
